title: EventBase
description: A single event handler entry in a component's events.onValueChange array. Targets a component and applies an action verb, optionally gated by a when expression.

componentName.description: The name of the component to target. Must match the name property of an existing component in the form.

action.description: The verb to apply. Most verbs target a component (componentName required). `notify` is a global toast and does not require componentName. `abortSubmit` is a control-flow verb meaningful only inside FormScript.OnSaveEvents — it sets the dispatch cancel flag so the host (ProcessFlowComponent / FormComponent) skips the actual save. Outside an OnSave dispatch, abortSubmit warn-logs and is a no-op.

valueExpression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in context { result, source, form }. Required for: setValue, setReadonly, setRequired, toggleVisible, setProperty. The expression is evaluated in a sandboxed JS evaluator — window/document/fetch/eval are blocked.

when.description: Optional guard expression. Evaluated in the same context as valueExpression. If falsy, this handler is skipped entirely.

message.description: Toast message text. Required when action is "notify".

severity.description: Toast severity. Required when action is "notify".

propertyName.description: Target schema property name. Required when action is "setProperty".

parameters.description: Additional parameters for pass-through verbs (data, validate, schema, schemaAndData, save, saveAndClose). Rarely needed.

examples.message: Selected office is already assigned to this user

examples.valueExpression: result.total > 0 ? [{ type: 'warning', text: 'This email is already registered' }] : []
